description: This file defines a final class `MotionService` that implements the `MotionServicing` protocol, providing asynchronous methods to access motion activity and pedometer data using iOS CoreMotion framework. It includes internal helpers for date range resolution and confidence string conversion.

classes.name: MotionService
classes.description: Provides methods to retrieve motion activities and pedometer data asynchronously, leveraging iOS CoreMotion APIs.

methods.name: activities
methods.description: Fetches motion activity data within a specified date range, returning an array of `OpenClawMotionActivityEntry` objects wrapped in `OpenClawMotionActivityPayload`.

methods.name: pedometer
methods.description: Fetches pedometer data within a specified date range, returning steps, distance, and floors ascended/descended as `OpenClawPedometerPayload`.

methods.name: resolveRange
methods.description: Converts start and end ISO8601 date strings into `Date` objects, defaulting to start of current day and current date if inputs are nil.

methods.name: confidenceString
methods.description: Converts `CMMotionActivityConfidence` enum values into string representations.
